queued_meals.name: Eggs Benedict
queued_meals.queue_note: One-time extra meal for the meal plan generated on 2026-05-16 so ingredients are in-house by Memorial Day weekend. Add as an extra breakfast meal; do not replace one of the normal 3 dinners.
queued_meals.freshness_notes: Best cooked day-of. Buy English muffins, Canadian bacon/ham, eggs, butter, and lemons with the May 16 meal-plan grocery order. Use eggs within a week; lemons and butter keep fine. Canadian bacon/ham should be refrigerated and used by package date.
queued_meals.onion_compliance: No onions, shallots, scallions, leeks, onion powder, or onion-containing sauces.

nutrition_estimate_per_serving.note: Estimated; varies with muffin size, hollandaise amount, and ham/Canadian bacon brand.

ingredients.item: Canadian bacon or thin ham slices

ingredients.notes: for hollandaise; separate from additional eggs
optional garnish; use parsley if avoiding anything onion-like

method: Melt butter until hot but not browned.
Blend egg yolks, lemon juice, Dijon, salt, and cayenne for 10 seconds.
With blender running, slowly stream in hot butter until sauce thickens. Keep warm, not hot.
Brown Canadian bacon or ham in a skillet until warm and lightly crisped.
Bring a wide pot of water to a gentle simmer. Add vinegar. Crack eggs into small cups, then slide into water and poach 3-4 minutes until whites are set and yolks are still soft.
Build each serving with toasted muffin halves, ham/Canadian bacon, one poached egg per half, hollandaise, black pepper, and optional parsley/chives.

protein_dairy: 12 oz Canadian bacon or thin ham slices
